base44_storage.strategy: upload critical files as backup redundancy layer

email_summary.strategy: email completion summary after backup_to_github.sh runs

backup_priorities.P0_CRITICAL: Cannot be regenerated — must be backed up to GitHub + Base44
backup_priorities.P1_HIGH: Difficult to regenerate — backed up to GitHub
backup_priorities.P2_MEDIUM: Can be regenerated with effort — backed up to GitHub
backup_priorities.P3_LOW: Easily regenerated — standard git tracking only

files_and_directories.notes: Entire project tree is the primary backup target

files_and_directories.description: Git repository metadata — history, objects, refs, configs
files_and_directories.notes: Git history is backed up via push to GitHub. Local .git is the source of truth.

files_and_directories.description: Git configuration — remote URLs, branch settings, resilience config
files_and_directories.notes: Contains GitHub remote URL and all resilience settings applied by git_permanent_fix.sh

files_and_directories.description: Git hooks — pre-commit hook for index corruption prevention
files_and_directories.notes: Custom pre-commit hook installed by git_permanent_fix.sh

files_and_directories.description: Python agent scripts — core AI agent logic
files_and_directories.notes: Primary agent implementation. All Python scripts must be preserved.

files_and_directories.description: Training data for the 12B model — cannot be regenerated
files_and_directories.notes: Training data is critical. Large binary model weights excluded (see model_weights/).

files_and_directories.description: Builder code — model construction and configuration
Local API server code — REST endpoints for model inference
Served HTML pages — web interface for the model
System configuration files — model config, server config, environment
files_and_directories.notes: All config files are P0 — losing these means losing model/server configuration.

files_and_directories.description: Architecture documentation — design docs, API docs, setup guides
files_and_directories.notes: Architecture docs are critical for reconstruction.
Critical for reconstruction — defines exact dependency versions.

files_and_directories.description: Environment variables — API keys, model paths, DB connections
files_and_directories.notes: WARNING: Contains secrets. NOT pushed to GitHub. Backed up to Base44 storage only. Must be manually re-created on reconstruction.
Template for .env — safe to push to GitHub.

files_and_directories.description: Model weight files (12B parameter) — large binaries
files_and_directories.notes: Large binary files (potentially 20+ GB for 12B model). Excluded from git (would exceed GitHub limits). Backed up to Base44 storage or external storage. Can be re-downloaded from HuggingFace if model is published.
Tokenizer is required for model inference.
Logs are low priority. Typically excluded from git. Can be regenerated.

files_and_directories.description: General data directory — datasets, caches, intermediate results
files_and_directories.notes: Mixed priority data. Binary arrays excluded (can be regenerated).

files_and_directories.description: Test suite — unit tests, integration tests
Utility modules — helper functions, shared code

files_and_directories.notes: Large binary checkpoint files. Excluded from git. Backed up to Base44 storage. The optimizer state JSON is small and can go to git.

system_level_backups.description: Shell configuration — aliases, PATH, environment setup
system_level_backups.notes: Needed to reconstruct the user's shell environment.

system_level_backups.description: Login profile — environment variables, startup commands
SSH keys and configuration — required for GitHub access and DGX access
system_level_backups.notes: SECURITY SENSITIVE: Contains private keys. Backed up to Base44 storage ONLY. Never pushed to git. Required for SSH-based git push to GitHub.

system_level_backups.description: Global git configuration — user name, email, credential helper
Git health check script — installed by git_permanent_fix.sh

system_level_backups.notes: Log file. Not backed up — regenerated by the health check cron job.

system_level_backups.description: System-wide git health check script (if installed with sudo)
User crontab entries — includes hourly git health check
system_level_backups.notes: Must be re-installed on reconstruction. Contains the hourly git fsck + auto-repair cron job.

system_level_backups.description: Conda environments — Python environment for the project
system_level_backups.notes: Large. Backed up as environment.yml export, not the full conda dir. Reconstructed via conda env create.
If present, defines the exact conda environment for reconstruction.

system_level_backups.description: Complete pip package list with versions
system_level_backups.notes: Generated by backup_to_github.sh via 'pip freeze > pip_freeze.txt'. Essential for reconstruction.
Generated by backup_to_github.sh via 'conda env export'. Essential for reconstruction.

backup_scripts.name: git_permanent_fix.sh
backup_scripts.description: Permanently fixes git index corruption and installs prevention mechanisms

backup_scripts.name: backup_to_github.sh
backup_scripts.description: Incremental backup — fixes git, stages, commits, pushes, uploads to Base44, emails summary

backup_scripts.name: reconstruct_dgx.sh
backup_scripts.description: Full reconstruction script — rebuilds entire DGX environment from GitHub + Base44

backup_scripts.name: full_backup_manifest.json
backup_scripts.description: This file — complete manifest of all files/directories to backup

exclusions.description: Patterns excluded from all backups (regenerable or too large)
exclusions.notes: Large model weights and checkpoints are backed up to Base44 storage separately, not via git.

reconstruction_order: 1. Run reconstruct_dgx.sh on a fresh DGX Spark
2. Script restores SSH keys from Base44 storage
6. Script restores model weights from Base44 storage
7. Script runs git_permanent_fix.sh to install prevention mechanisms
9. Script starts API server and verifies health
verification_checklist: git fsck --full passes with no errors
All 97+ files present and match manifest
pre-commit hook is installed and executable
crontab has hourly git health check entry
git config shows resilience settings (gc.auto, pack.threads, core.preloadindex, etc.)
GitHub push succeeds without index corruption
API server starts and responds on expected port
